Players Committee card image of [[General Grievous (ALT)]] (the same image re-uploaded as a full-size GIF; recorded with that printing, not as a separate version), game text: “Any stolen lightsaber may deploy on Grievous. Once per game, Grievous may steal a lightsaber from opponent's Lost Pile. Unless alone, may lose 1 Force to return Grievous (and your cards on him) to hand from a site you control. Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/generalgrievous_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/1c540d0df3ebba5b7a98f95e23a8f04039234a08 1c540d0] (4 September 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
